summary: QA- End to End Validation for JavaScript tool "ESLINT"
description:
## Summary

Perform end-to-end validation of the **ESLINT** tool on a **JavaScript** repository using the Testable QA environment. Verify successful execution, metric/report accuracy, and correct platform ingestion.

### Objective

Validate that **ESLINT** integrates correctly with the Testable White Box analysis pipeline and produces the expected outputs mapped in **Testable_Strategy_Metrics_Mapping_v0.2** (White Box sheet).

Primary JavaScript lint/static-analysis tool for rule-violation metrics.

### Strategy Mapping Reference

| Item | Value |
| --- | --- |
| Source file | Testable_Strategy_Metrics_Mapping_v0.2 (White Box sheet) |
| Tool | ESLINT |
| Metrics covered by this tool | **11** |
| Language focus | JavaScript |

### Metrics Covered (from Strategy v0.2)

| L3 Technique | L4 Classification | L5 Metric | JS Primary | JS Secondary |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Lint / Rule Violations | Rule Detection Test | Violation Density per KLOC | eslint | — |
| Lint / Rule Violations | Unused Variable Detection | Resource Waste Identification | eslint | — |
| Lint / Rule Violations | Naming Convention Validation | Semantic Consistency Score | eslint | — |
| Lint / Rule Violations | Code Style Rule Validation | Syntactic Uniformity Score | eslint | — |
| Lint / Rule Violations | Complexity Rule Detection | Structural Threshold Monitoring | eslint | — |
| Lint / Rule Violations | Rule Severity Classification | Impact Prioritization | eslint | — |
| Lint / Rule Violations | Multiple Violations Detection | Aggregated Risk Assessment | eslint | — |
| Lint / Rule Violations | False Positive Prevention | Accuracy Tuning | eslint | — |
| Lint / Rule Violations | Configuration File Handling | Environment Standardization | eslint | — |
| Lint / Rule Violations | CI/CD Integration Validation | Automated Gatekeeping | eslint | — |
| Lint / Rule Violations | Violation Reporting Validation | Quality Audit Trail | eslint | — |

### Validation Scope

* Verify the tool executes successfully on a representative JavaScript repository.
* Confirm raw tool output is generated without errors.
* Validate mapped metrics above are present directly or via documented derivation.
* Compare platform-ingested values with local tool execution.
* Ensure reports are stored/displayed correctly in Testable.

### Expected Result

* **ESLINT** completes execution successfully.
* All **11** mapped metrics are supported or correctly derived.
* Results display correctly in Testable without tool failure messages.

### Deliverables

* End-to-end validation results
* Execution logs
* Generated ESLINT report/output
* Screenshots of successful execution (if applicable)
